original.statement: The config setting use_boltdb_shipper_as_backup (-tsdb.shipper.use-boltdb-shipper-as-backup) is removed in Loki 3.0.0; the previous default false is applied.

decision.reason: [ev-cd1836b0f962] says the setting `use_boltdb_shipper_as_backup`, with its CLI flag spelled `-tsdb.shipper.use-boltdb-shipper-as-backup`, "was removed". [ev-4c9440970051] confirms the removal in 3.0.0. The cli-flag subject keeps the single-dash spelling the text uses. The change type "removed" is right, and before/after are optional and set to nil. The "previous default value false is applied" line describes what happens after removal. It is not a before value for the flag.
